paragraphs.text: He desires God to undertake his cause against the enemies but chiefly that he would restore him to the tabernacle.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: That is, the cruel company of my enemies.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: That is, your favour which appears by the performance of your promises.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: He promises to offer a solemn sacrifice of thanksgiving in token of his great deliverance.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: will I go unto the altar

paragraphs.text: By which he admonishes the faithful not to relent but constantly to wait on the Lord, though their troubles are long and great.
paragraphs.label: e
